content.text: {"id": "mm6346a19", "data_focus": {"v": "yes", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "The age-adjusted death rate for drug poisoning more than quadrupled from 3.0 per 100,000 in 1979 to 13.1 in 2012."}, {"loc": "text", "q": "In 2012, a total of 41,502 drug poisoning deaths, 34,935 motor vehicle traffic deaths, and 33,563 firearm deaths occurred."}]}, "outcome_types": [{"v": "count/rate", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "The age-adjusted death rate for drug poisoning more than quadrupled from 3.0 per 100,000 in 1979 to 13.1 in 2012."}, {"loc": "text", "q": "In 2012, a total of 41,502 drug poisoning deaths, 34,935 motor vehicle traffic deaths, and 33,563 firearm deaths occurred."}]}], "analytic_depth": [{"v": "summary", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "In 2012, a total of 41,502 drug poisoning deaths, 34,935 motor vehicle traffic deaths, and 33,563 firearm deaths occurred."}]}, {"v": "comparison", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "The age-adjusted drug poisoning death rate exceeded the motor vehicle traffic death rate beginning in 2009."}, {"loc": "text", "q": "In contrast, the age-adjusted rate dropped from 22.1 to 10.9 for motor vehicle traffic deaths"}]}], "study_design": [{"v": "surveillance/descriptive", "ev": [{"loc": "note", "q": "Source: CDC WONDER, compressed mortality file, underlying cause-of-death"}]}, {"v": "before/after or trend", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "The age-adjusted death rate for drug poisoning more than quadrupled from 3.0 per 100,000 in 1979 to 13.1 in 2012."}]}], "methods_quotes": [{"loc": "note", "q": "Per 100,000, age-adjusted to the 2000 U.S. standard population"}, {"loc": "note", "q": "death rates for 1998 and earlier are not directly comparable with those computed after 1998"}], "confidence": "high", "uncertain_fields": []}
